notes: NORTHBROWN 2.0.9 adds Design DNA v1. Every new or regenerated demo gets a business-fit design strategy before copy or HTML is assembled, including archetype, hero, navigation, layout grid, service presentation, trust/review treatment, CTA, footer and page plan. The builder compares the design fingerprint with the 10 most recent demos, enforces a minimum 72% design difference, blocks repeated hero+service combinations and repeated first-four section sequences, and assembles the page from reusable components instead of one fixed website blueprint. Business-fit scores below 70 are rejected. A new regenerate-design endpoint creates a fresh validated Design DNA without changing the prospect data. The OTA bridge downloads the signed-in-repo Design DNA payload in verified gzip parts, checks both transport and overlay SHA-256 hashes, compiles the patched Python before replacing live files, and relies on the updater-created 2.0.8 backup for rollback on failure.
